SELECT T.* , T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS SXDC , NVL(T2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM,'교육생') AS STTS , T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PRGRS_STTS FROM ( SELECT T2.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ , T4.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 과정명 */ , DEC_B64(NVL(T3.FLNM_ENCPT,C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM /* 대상자명 */ , DEC_B64(T3.RRNO_ENCPT) AS RRNO /* 주민등록번호 */ , NVL(T3.BRTH_YMD,C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 생년월일 */ , NVL(T3.SXDC_SE_CD,C.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_CD /* 성별[코드] */ , TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (SYSDATE,NVL(T3.BRTH_YMD,C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD)) /12,0) AS INTERNTNL_AGE /* 만 나이 */ , DEC_B64(NVL(T3.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT,C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT)) AS TELNO /* 전화번호 */ , DEC_B64(NVL(T3.EML_ADDR_ENCPT,C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT)) AS EML /* 이메일 */ , NVL(T3.ZIP,C.ZIP) AS ZIP /* 우편번호 */ , NVL(T3.PST_ADDR,C.PST_ADDR) || ' ' || NVL(T3.DADDR,C.DADDR) AS ADDR /* 주소 */ , T.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS PRTCLR_MATTER_CN /* 특이사항 */ , T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD AS STTS_CD /* 상태[코드] */ , T.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS PRGRS_STTS_CD /* 진행상태 */ , (SELECT COUNT(C3.RESRCE_NO) FROM SEB510 C1 JOIN SEB500 C2 ON C2.SRVC_PVSN_NO = C1.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND C2.RESRCE_NO = C1.RESRCE_NO JOIN SDA100 C3 ON C3.RESRCE_NO = C2.RESRCE_NO WHERE C3.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD = '01' AND C1.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND C1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C1.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND C2.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) AS DSCSN_NOCS /* 상담건수 */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '020401' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_OFCDC /* 입소경로_교육청(교육부 관련기관) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '020801' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_POLICE /* 입소경로_경찰청(경찰청 관련기관) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '020501' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_PRTCTN_DSPS /* 입소경로_보호처분(법무부 관련기관) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '020301' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_WLFAR_FCLTY /* 입소경로_복지시설(보건복지부 관련기관) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '020201' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_DREAM /* 입소경로_꿈드림센터(청소년 지원기관) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = '010101' THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_ME /* 입소경로_본인(개인) */ , CASE WHEN C.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD NOT IN ('020401', '020801', '020501', '020301', '020201', '010101') THEN 'O' END AS ENTRNC_COURS_ETC /* 입소경로_기타(가족연계포함) */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD, D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0202') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_ELESCH_DROOSC /* 최종학력_초중퇴 */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD, D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0203', '0301','0304') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_ELESCH_GRDTN /* 최종학력_초졸업 */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD, D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0302') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_MSKUL_DROOSC /* 최종학력_중중퇴 */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD ,D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0303', '0401','0404') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_MSKUL_GRDTN /* 최종학력_중졸업 */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD, D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0402') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_HGSCHL_DROOSC /* 최종학력_고중퇴 */ , CASE WHEN CONCAT(D.ACBG_SE_CD, D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD) IN ('0403', '0501','0504', '0601','0604') THEN 'O' END AS LAST_ACBG_HGSCHL_GRDTN /* 최종학력_고졸업 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '045' THEN 'O' END AS ACBG_ACQS_RCGN_ANCMNT /* 학력취득_검정고시 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '043' THEN 'O' END AS ACBG_ACQS_UPPER_SCHL_ERTDS /* 학력취득_상급학교진학 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '046' THEN 'O' END AS ACBG_ACQS_REINSTATEMENT /* 학력취득_복교 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD BETWEEN '042' AND '048' THEN 'O' END AS EDU_STTS_FNSH /* 훈련상태_수료 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('049','050','051','052','053','056') THEN 'O' END AS EDU_STTS_MDSTRM_FAILR /* 훈련상태_순중도탈락 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('054','055') THEN 'O' END AS EDU_STTS_ELPD_EMPYMN /* 훈련상태_조기취업(50%미만) */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('049','050','051','052','053','056') THEN T5.CASE_TRMN_YMD END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_YMD /* 순중도탈락사유_중도탈락일 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '049' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_LVLHD_DIFF /* 순중도탈락사유_생계곤란 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '051' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_PROGRM_MALADJ /* 순중도탈락사유_훈련부적응 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '050' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_OCPT_NOT_STBLT /* 순중도탈락사유_직종부적합 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '052' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_WTRMS_LVNG /* 순중도탈락사유_무단퇴소 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '053' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_FRIENDSHIP /* 순중도탈락사유_교우관계 */ , CASE WHEN T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '056' THEN 'O' END AS MDSTRM_FAILR_ETC /* 순중도탈락사유_기타 */ , T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD_ETC_CN AS MDSTRM_FAILR_ETC_DTL_CS /* 순중도탈락사유_상세사유 */ , (SELECT LISTAGG(CERTI_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CERTI_NM) FROM SEA260 WHERE B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD < ACQS_YMD AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO) AS CERTI_ACQS_NM /*자격증취득(자격증명)*/ ,CASE E.SAMENS_REALMM_EMPYMN_YN_SE_CD WHEN 'Y' THEN 'O' END AS EMPYMN_INST_RELATA_REALMM /* 취업처_관련분야 */ ,CASE E.SAMENS_REALMM_EMPYMN_YN_SE_CD WHEN 'N' THEN 'O' END AS EMPYMN_INST_NOT_RELATA_REALMM /* 취업처_비관련분야 */ -- , EMPYMN_INST_BPLC_50DOWN /* 취업처_50인미만 */ -- , EMPYMN_INST_BPLC_50UPPER /* 취업처_50인이상 */ , CASE E.EMPYMN_TYPE_SE_CD WHEN '01' THEN 'O' END AS EMPYMN_INST_RGLLBR /* 취업처_정규직 */ , CASE E.EMPYMN_TYPE_SE_CD WHEN '02' THEN 'O' END AS EMPYMN_INST_NOT_RGLLBR /* 취업처_비정규직 */ , E.JNCMP_YMD AS EMPYMN_INST_EMPYMN_YMD /* 취업처_취업일 */ , E.CO_NM AS EMPYMN_INST_BPLC_NM /* 취업처_사업장명 */ -- , EMPYMN_INST_BRNO /* 취업처_사업자등록번호 */ , E.SALARY_AMT AS EMPYMN_INST_SALARY /* 취업처_급여 */ FROM SEB510 A /* 자원프로그램제공 */ JOIN SEB500 T0 ON T0.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T0.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND T0.DEL_YN != 'Y' JOIN SDA100 B /* 자원기본 */ ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND B.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' LEFT JOIN SEB100 T /* 사례기본 */ ON T.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 C /* 대상자정보 */ ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = T.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 T3 /* 개인정보 */ ON T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY T2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, T1.MNG_SN DESC ) AS RNUM FROM SEA230 T1 /* 학력상태 */ LEFT JOIN SAC100 T2 /* 공통코드값 */ ON T2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND T2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) D ON D.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND D.RNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY T1.MNG_SN DESC ) AS RNUM FROM SEA250 T1 /* 취업정보 */ WHERE T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) E ON E.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND E.RNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN SDA420 T1 /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T2 /* 서비스사업 */ ON T2.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 T4 /* 통합기관 */ ON T4.INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT B.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASE_MNG_NO, B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY B.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RNUM FROM SEC100 A LEFT JOIN SEC100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND B.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' ) T5 /* 사례종결 */ ON T.CASE_MNG_NO = T5.CASE_MNG_NO AND T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T5.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T5.RNUM = 1
WHERE T4.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD <> '060' OR T5.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IS NULL) AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T2.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND B.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND B.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2'
ORDER BY B.RSFR_INST_NO, B.RESRCE_NO DESC, A.CASE_MNG_NO ) T LEFT JOIN SAC100 T1 ON T1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SXDC_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 T2 ON T2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND T2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.STTS_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 T3 ON T3.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.PRGRS_STTS_CD

/* isry.aimns.statsmgmt.stats.mapper.StatsMapper - selectMonthExecStatusStatsList[Lee SangHoon] */
WITH TMP000 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T1.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , T4.TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , T4.SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T6A.CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T6.TRMN_CS_SE_CD -- 종결사유구분코드 , REGEXP_SUBSTR(T3.YNGBGS_SE_NO, '01') AS OSCHL_YNGBGS --학교밖청소년 , REGEXP_SUBSTR(T3.YNGBGS_SE_NO, '03') AS LVM_YNGBGS -- 가정밖청소년 , REGEXP_SUBSTR(T3.YNGBGS_SE_NO, '04') AS BOMGT_YNGBGS -- 이주배경청소년 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO, T1. RESRCE_NO, T2.CASE_MNG_NO, T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY T6.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS ROW_NUMBER
FROM SDA100 T8 JOIN SEB500 T1 /* 서비스제공 */ ON T8.RESRCE_NO = T1.RESRCE_NO JOIN SEB510 T2 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T2.RESRCE_NO = T1.RESRCE_NO AND T2.DEL_YN <> 'Y' JOIN SEB100 T3 /* 사례기본 */ ON T3.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN SEA200 T4 /* 대상자정보 */ ON T4.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T4.DEL_YN <> 'Y' LEFT JOIN SEC100 T6A /* 사례종결(승인) */ ON T6A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' AND T6A.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T6A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEC100 T6 /* 사례종결(신청) */ ON T6.CASE_MNG_NO = T6A.CASE_MNG_NO AND T6.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T6A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T6.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE T1.DEL_YN <> 'Y' AND (T6.TRMN_CS_SE_CD <> '060' OR T6.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IS NULL) AND T8.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND T8.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND #{BIZ_YM} BETWEEN SUBSTR(T8.PVSN_BGNG_YMD,1,6) AND SUBSTR(T8.PVSN_END_YMD,1,6) ) WHERE ROW_NUMBER = 1 )
SELECT #{BIZ_YM} AS BIZ_YM -- 사업연월 , B.INST_NM AS INST_NM -- 기관명 , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM -- 과정명 , A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS PVSN_BGNG_YMD -- 제공시작일자 , A.PVSN_END_YMD AS PVSN_END_YMD -- 제공종료일자 , NVL(C.PREPAR_SCHL_TIME,0) AS PREPAR_SCHL_TIME -- 예비학교 , NVL(C.OCCP_TRAING_TIME,0) AS OCCP_TRAING_TIME -- 직업훈련 , NVL(C.SPCLIZ_PROGRM_TIME,0) AS SPCLIZ_PROGRM_TIME -- 특화교육 , NVL(C.PROGRM_TIME_TOTAL,0) AS PROGRM_TIME_TOTAL -- 총시간 , (SELECT COUNT(CASE_MNG_NO) FROM SEB510 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND DEL_YN != 'Y') AS PTCPTN_NOPE -- 배정인원 , NVL(D.PROGRM_TRPR_SUBTOTAL,0) AS PROGRM_TRPR_SUBTOTAL -- 교육생인원 소계 , NVL(D.PROGRM_M_CUNT,0) AS PROGRM_M_CUNT -- 교육생인원 남 , NVL(D.PROGRM_F_CUNT,0) AS PROGRM_F_CUNT -- 교육생인원 여 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_ELPD_EMPYMN_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_ELPD_EMPYMN_CUNT -- 중도탈락 조기취업 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_LVLHD_DIFF_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_LVLHD_DIFF_CUNT -- 순중도탈락 생계곤란 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_PROGRM_MALADJ_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_PROGRM_MALADJ_CUNT -- 순중도탈락 훈련부적응 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_FRIENDSHIP_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_FRIENDSHIP_CUNT -- 순중도탈락 교우관계 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_ELPD_ERTDS_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_ELPD_ERTDS_CUNT -- 순중도탈락 조기진학 , NVL(E.MDSTRM_FAILR_ETC_CUNT,0) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_ETC_CUNT -- 순중도탈락 기타 , NVL(E.PROGRM_NOT_FNSH_CUNT,0) AS PROGRM_NOT_FNSH_CUNT -- 미수료 , NVL(E.FNSH_ETC_CUNT,0) AS FNSH_ETC_CUNT -- 수료 기타 , NVL(E.EMPYMN_ELPD_EMPYMN_CUNT,0) AS EMPYMN_ELPD_EMPYMN_CUNT -- 취업 조기취업 , NVL(E.EMPYMN_FNSH_EMPYMN_CUNT,0) AS EMPYMN_FNSH_EMPYMN_CUNT -- 취업 수료후취업 취업 , NVL(E.EMPYMN_FNSH_FOUND_CUNT,0) AS EMPYMN_FNSH_FOUND_CUNT -- 취업 수료후취업 창업 , NVL(F.QLFC_ACQS_SUBTOTAL,0) AS QLFC_ACQS_SUBTOTAL -- 자격취득수 소계 , NVL(F.QLFC_ACQS_ENGINEER_CUNT,0) AS QLFC_ACQS_ENGINEER_CUNT -- 자격취득수 기사 , ACBG_ACQS_RCGN_ANCMNT_CUNT -- 학력취득 검정고시(학력취득용) , NVL(E.ACBG_ACQS_UPPER_SCHL_ERTDS_CUNT,0) + NVL(H.ACBG_ACQS_UPPER_SCHL_ERTDS_CUNT, 0) AS ACBG_ACQS_UPPER_SCHL_ERTDS_CUNT -- 학력취득 상급학교진학(학력취득용) , NVL(E.ACBG_ACQS_REINSTATEMENT_CUNT,0) + NVL(H.ACBG_ACQS_REINSTATEMENT_CUNT, 0) AS ACBG_ACQS_REINSTATEMENT_CUNT -- 학력취득 복교(학력취득용) , NVL(G.PRTCLR_MATTER_OSCHL_YNGBGS_CUNT,0) AS PRTCLR_MATTER_OSCHL_YNGBGS_CUNT -- 특이사항 학교밖청소년 , NVL(G.PRTCLR_MATTER_LVM_YNGBGS_CUNT,0) AS PRTCLR_MATTER_LVM_YNGBGS_CUNT -- 특이사항 가정밖청소년 , NVL(G.PRTCLR_MATTER_BOMGT_YNGBGS_CUNT,0) AS COUNT(CASE WHEN G.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '060' THEN 1 END) AS UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE , A.UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE AS PTCPTN_NOPE , COUNT(CASE WHEN G.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042','043','044','045','046','047','048') THEN 1 END) AS FNSH_CUNT , E.PREPAR_SCHL_TIME , E.OCCP_TRAING_TIME , E.COSE_DESIGN_TIME , E.SPCLIZ_PROGRM_TIME , E.EMPYMN_SPRT_TIME , E.SLFRL_ABILIT_STRNGT_TIME , E.PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL1 , E.PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL2 FROM SDA100 A INNER JOIN SAA000 B ON A.RSFR_INST_NO = B.INST_NO INNER JOIN SDA420 C ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SDA400 D ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = '01' THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS PREPAR_SCHL_TIME /*교육프로그램 구분코드 예비학교 - 프로그램 합계시간의 합*/ , NVL(SUM( /* 특화교육 공통코드(03) 제거됨.*/ CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = '03' THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS SPCLIZ_PROGRM_TIME /*교육프로그램 구분코드 특화교육 - 프로그램 합계시간의 합*/ , NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = '09' THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS EMPYMN_SPRT_TIME /*교육프로그램 구분코드 취업지원 - 프로그램 합계시간의 합*/ , NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = '10' THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS SLFRL_ABILIT_STRNGT_TIME /*교육프로그램 구분코드 자립역량강화 - 프로그램 합계시간의 합*/ , NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL1 /*총시간*/ , NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD IN ('01', '02', '08', '09', '10') THEN PROGRM_SUM_HR END), 0) AS PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL2 /*총시간*/ , RESRCE_NO FROM SDA300 WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY RESRCE_NO ) E ON A.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO INNER JOIN SEB510 F ON F.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )G ON G.CASE_MNG_NO = F.CASE_MNG_NO AND G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND G.RN=1 WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND A.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' /*서비스자원대분류구분코드(상담)*/ GROUP BY D.BIZ_YR , B.INST_NO , B.INST_NM , A.RESRCE_NO , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , A.UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE , E.PREPAR_SCHL_TIME , E.OCCP_TRAING_TIME , E.COSE_DESIGN_TIME , E.SPCLIZ_PROGRM_TIME , E.EMPYMN_SPRT_TIME , E.SLFRL_ABILIT_STRNGT_TIME , E.PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL1 , E.PROGRM_TIME_SUBTOTAL2 ) B ON A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO ORDER BY A.INST_NO, A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD

/* selectReportStatsStudntEduList (통계보고서 - 교육생 교육) - Seoung Jae Lee */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT D.BIZ_YR , B.INST_NO , B.INST_NM , A.RESRCE_NO , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , H.TRMN_CS_SE_CD , I.SXDC_SE_CD , I.TRPR_INFO_NO , G.CASE_MNG_NO , G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , F.SRVC_PVSN_NO , J.DSCSN_CUNT , (SELECT COUNT(MNG_SN) FROM SEA260 AA WHERE AA.TRPR_INFO_NO = I.TRPR_INFO_NO AND AA.OUTC_SE_CD = '2' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.ACQS_YMD BETWEEN A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AND A.PVSN_END_YMD ) AS QLFC_ACQS_CUNT --자격증SEA260MNG_SN , (SELECT COUNT(MNG_SN) FROM SEA230 AA WHERE AA.TRPR_INFO_NO = I.TRPR_INFO_NO AND AA.OUTC_SE_CD = '2' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.DGRI_ACQS_ERA_YM BETWEEN A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AND A.PVSN_END_YMD AND AA.DGRI_ACQS_MTHD_SE_CD = '2' -- 학위취득방법구분코드 ) AS RCGN_ANCMNT_CUNT --학력SEA230MNG_SN
FROM SDA100 A INNER JOIN SAA000 B /*통합기관 테이블*/ ON A.RSFR_INST_NO = B.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ INNER JOIN SDA420 C /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /*서비스실행사업번호*/ INNER JOIN SDA400 D /*서비스사업 테이블*/ ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO /*서비스사업번호*/ INNER JOIN SEB510 F ON F.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' INNER JOIN SEB100 G ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = G.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO INNER JOIN SEA200 I ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = I.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.CASE_MNG_NO , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD , A.CASE_TRMN_YMD , B.TRMN_SE_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASE_MNG_NO, B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY B.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 A LEFT JOIN SEC100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND B.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' ) H ON H.CASE_MNG_NO = F.CASE_MNG_NO AND H.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND H.RN=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AA.CASE_MNG_NO , AA.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , DD.RSFR_INST_NO , COUNT(AA.SRVC_PVSN_NO) AS DSCSN_CUNT FROM SEB510 AA JOIN SDA100 DD ON DD.RESRCE_NO = AA.RESRCE_NO WHERE AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND DD.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY AA.CASE_MNG_NO, AA.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, DD.RSFR_INST_NO ) J ON J.CASE_MNG_NO = G.CASE_MNG_NO AND J.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND J.RSFR_INST_NO = B.INST_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND A.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' /*서비스자원대분류구분코드(상담)*/ )
SELECT A.BIZ_YR , A.INST_NM , A.INST_NO , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , A.RESRCE_NO , A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD , COUNT(B.SRVC_PVSN_NO) - COUNT(CASE WHEN B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '060' THEN 1 END) AS PTCPTN_NOPE , COUNT(CASE WHEN B.SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' AND (B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD != '060' OR B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS PROGRM_M_CUNT /*남자*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN B.SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' AND (B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD != '060' OR B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS PROGRM_F_CUNT /*여자*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('049','050','051','052','053','054','055','056') THEN 1 END) AS MDSTRM_FAILR_CUNT /*중도탈락*/ , NVL(SUM(B.QLFC_ACQS_CUNT),0) AS QLFC_ACQS_CUNT /*자격증획득*/ , NVL(SUM(B.RCGN_ANCMNT_CUNT),0) + NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '045' THEN 1 END),0) AS RCGN_ANCMNT_CUNT /*검정고시취득*/ , NVL(SUM(B.DSCSN_CUNT),0) AS DSCSN_CUNT /*상담건수*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042','043','044','045','046','047','048') THEN 1 END) AS PROGRM_FNSH_CUNT /*수료*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN B.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042','047') THEN 1 END) AS PROGRM_EMPYMN_CUNT /*조기취업*/ FROM ( SELECT C.BIZ_YR , A.INST_NM , A.INST_NO , D.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , D.RESRCE_NO , D.PVSN_BGNG_YMD , D.PVSN_END_YMD FROM SAA000 A INNER JOIN SDA100 D ON A.INST_NO = D.RSFR_INST_NO INNER JOIN SDA420 B ON D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SDA400 C ON B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_BIZ_NO WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND C.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND A.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND D.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' AND D.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND D.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' /*서비스자원대분류구분코드(상담)*/ GROUP BY C.BIZ_YR, A.INST_NO, A.INST_NM, D.RESRCE_NO, D.PVSN_RESRCE_NM, D.PVSN_BGNG_YMD, D.PVSN_END_YMD ) A LEFT JOIN TMP B ON A.BIZ_YR = B.BIZ_YR AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO GROUP BY A.BIZ_YR , A.INST_NM , A.INST_NO , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , A.RESRCE_NO , A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD ORDER BY A.INST_NM, A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD
